I need to add a comprehensive debug IO port to the Coral NPU Chisel design. The testbench (`/app/tests/verilator_sim/coralnpu/core_mini_axi_tb.h`) expects these ports on `CoreMiniAxi` (the Verilator model):

From the testbench header:
- `io_debug_en`: Input(UInt(4.W))  (4-bit, `sc_bv<4>`)
- `io_debug_cycles`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_addr_0..3`: Output(UInt(32.W)) — 4 fetch addresses
- `io_debug_inst_0..3`: Output(UInt(32.W)) — 4 fetch instructions
- `io_debug_dbus_valid`: Output(Bool())
- `io_debug_dbus_bits_addr`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_dbus_bits_wdata`: Output(UInt(lsuDataBits.W)) — 128-bit for this config
- `io_debug_dbus_bits_write`: Output(Bool())
- `io_debug_dispatch_0..3_instFire`: Output(Bool())
- `io_debug_dispatch_0..3_instAddr`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_dispatch_0..3_instInst`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_regfile_writeAddr_0..3_valid`: Output(Bool()) — 4 ports
- `io_debug_regfile_writeAddr_0..3_bits`: Output(UInt(5.W))
- `io_debug_regfile_writeData_0..5_valid`: Output(Bool()) — 6 ports
- `io_debug_regfile_writeData_0..5_bits_addr`: Output(UInt(5.W))
- `io_debug_regfile_writeData_0..5_bits_data`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_float_writeAddr_valid`: Output(Bool())
- `io_debug_float_writeAddr_bits`: Output(UInt(5.W))
- `io_debug_float_writeData_0..1_valid`: Output(Bool()) — 2 ports
- `io_debug_float_writeData_0..1_bits_addr`: Output(UInt(32.W)) — 32-bit!
- `io_debug_float_writeData_0..1_bits_data`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_rb_inst_0..7_valid`: Output(Bool()) — 8 entries (KP_retirementBufferSize=8)
- `io_debug_rb_inst_0..7_bits_pc`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_rb_inst_0..7_bits_inst`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_rb_inst_0..7_bits_idx`: Output(UInt(4.W)) — KP_retirementBufferIdxWidth=4
- `io_debug_rb_inst_0..7_bits_data`: Output(UInt(32.W))
- `io_debug_rb_inst_0..7_bits_trap`: Output(Bool())

Key files to read first (do NOT skip this step):
1. Read `/app/hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/Interfaces.scala` — current interface definitions
2. Read `/app/hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/RetirementBuffer.scala` — understand `io.entries`
3. Read `/app/hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/scalar/SCore.scala` — the pipeline; has `regfile`, `rb`, `fetcher`, `dispatch_debug` 
4. Read `/app/hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/Core.scala` — wraps SCore, already has `io` bundle
5. Read `/app/hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/CoreAxi.scala` — top-level RawModule

## What to implement:

### 1. `Interfaces.scala` — add new bundle classes BEFORE the existing content ends, in the `coralnpu` package:

```scala
class CoreDebugBundle(p: Parameters) extends Bundle {
  val en     = Input(UInt(4.W))
  val cycles = Output(UInt(32.W))
  val addr   = Vec(4, Output(UInt(32.W)))
  val inst   = Vec(4, Output(UInt(32.W)))
  val dbus   = Output(new Bundle {
    val valid = Bool()
    val bits  = new Bundle {
      val addr  = UInt(32.W)
      val wdata = UInt(p.lsuDataBits.W)
      val write = Bool()
    }
  })
  val dispatch         = Vec(4, Output(new DispatchDebugInfo))
  val regfile_writeAddr = Vec(4, Output(new Bundle {
    val valid = Bool()
    val bits  = UInt(5.W)
  }))
  val regfile_writeData = Vec(6, Output(new Bundle {
    val valid = Bool()
    val bits  = new Bundle {
      val addr = UInt(5.W)
      val data = UInt(32.W)
    }
  }))
  val float_writeAddr = Output(new Bundle {
    val valid = Bool()
    val bits  = UInt(5.W)
  })
  val float_writeData = Vec(2, Output(new Bundle {
    val valid = Bool()
    val bits  = new Bundle {
      val addr = UInt(32.W)
      val data = UInt(32.W)
    }
  }))
  val rb_inst = Vec(RetirementBufferConfig.size, Output(new Bundle {
    val valid = Bool()
    val bits  = new Bundle {
      val pc   = UInt(32.W)
      val inst = UInt(32.W)
      val idx  = UInt(RetirementBufferConfig.idxWidth.W)
      val data = UInt(32.W)
      val trap = Bool()
    }
  }))
}
```

Also update `RetirementBufferDebugEntry` to add `valid` field and change `idx` to 4-bit:
```scala
class RetirementBufferDebugEntry(rvvVlen: Int = 32) extends Bundle {
  val valid = Bool()  // ADD THIS
  val pc   = UInt(32.W)
  val inst = UInt(32.W)
  val idx  = UInt(RetirementBufferConfig.idxWidth.W)  // change from 8.W
  val data = UInt(rvvVlen.W)
  val trap = Bool()
}
```

### 2. `RetirementBuffer.scala` — update `io.entries` to set `valid`:

In the `for (i <- 0 until size)` loop, add:
```scala
io.entries(i).valid := valid(i)
```

### 3. `SCore.scala` — add `debug` to io bundle and wire it:

Add to the io Bundle:
```scala
val debug = new CoreDebugBundle(p)
```

Wire in the body (add after existing dispatch_debug code):
```scala
// Cycle counter
val cycleCount = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
cycleCount := cycleCount + 1.U
io.debug.cycles := cycleCount

// Fetch addresses and instructions
for (i <- 0 until nInst) {
  io.debug.addr(i) := fetcher.io.fetch.bits.addr  // all slots get same fetch group addr
  io.debug.inst(i) := fetcher.io.fetch.bits.inst(i)
}

// DBus
io.debug.dbus.valid       := io.dbus.valid
io.debug.dbus.bits.addr   := io.dbus.addr
io.debug.dbus.bits.wdata  := io.dbus.wdata
io.debug.dbus.bits.write  := io.dbus.write

// Dispatch
for (i <- 0 until 4) {
  io.debug.dispatch(i) := io.dispatch_debug(i)
}

// Regfile write ports (4 addr ports, 6 data ports)
for (i <- 0 until 4) {
  io.debug.regfile_writeAddr(i).valid := regfile.io.write_ports(i).valid
  io.debug.regfile_writeAddr(i).bits  := regfile.io.write_ports(i).addr
}
for (i <- 0 until 6) {
  io.debug.regfile_writeData(i).valid      := regfile.io.write_ports(i).valid
  io.debug.regfile_writeData(i).bits.addr  := regfile.io.write_ports(i).addr
  io.debug.regfile_writeData(i).bits.data  := regfile.io.write_ports(i).data
}

// Float regfile (not implemented, tie off)
io.debug.float_writeAddr.valid := false.B
io.debug.float_writeAddr.bits  := 0.U
for (i <- 0 until 2) {
  io.debug.float_writeData(i).valid      := false.B
  io.debug.float_writeData(i).bits.addr  := 0.U
  io.debug.float_writeData(i).bits.data  := 0.U
}

// Retirement buffer entries
for (i <- 0 until RetirementBufferConfig.size) {
  io.debug.rb_inst(i).valid      := rb.io.entries(i).valid
  io.debug.rb_inst(i).bits.pc    := rb.io.entries(i).pc
  io.debug.rb_inst(i).bits.inst  := rb.io.entries(i).inst
  io.debug.rb_inst(i).bits.idx   := rb.io.entries(i).idx
  io.debug.rb_inst(i).bits.data  := rb.io.entries(i).data
  io.debug.rb_inst(i).bits.trap  := rb.io.entries(i).trap
}
```

Note: `io.debug.en` is an Input — SCore doesn't need to DO anything with it, it just passes through. But since it's in the io bundle as Input, it's automatically a port.

### 4. `Core.scala` — add `debug` to io bundle and wire:

In the `io = IO(new Bundle {` section, add:
```scala
val debug = new CoreDebugBundle(p)
```

Then wire (in the SCore connection section):
```scala
score.io.debug <> io.debug
```

### 5. `CoreAxi.scala` — add `io_debug` as top-level IO and wire:

After the existing `val io_dm_rsp = IO(...)` declaration, add:
```scala
val io_debug = IO(new CoreDebugBundle(p))
```

Inside the `withClockAndReset` block (after `core.io.dm_rsp <> io_dm_rsp`), add:
```scala
core.io.debug <> io_debug
```

## IMPORTANT NOTES:
- In Chisel, when you have `Input(...)` and `Output(...)` inside a Bundle, the `<>` operator flips directions correctly
- The `CoreDebugBundle` has `en` as `Input` and everything else as `Output` — from the DUT's perspective
- In CoreAxi (a RawModule), when you `IO(new CoreDebugBundle(p))`, the `en` becomes an input pin and everything else becomes output pins — which is correct

Please implement all 5 changes. Be careful with:
- Anonymous Bundle classes in Chisel — these work fine in Chisel 5
- The `RetirementBufferDebugEntry` is used in both `Interfaces.scala` and `RetirementBuffer.scala` — update both
- Do NOT add `valid` to the OLD `RetirementBufferDebugEntry` class since it's also used in `io.entries` in RetirementBuffer — INSTEAD, the new `CoreDebugBundle.rb_inst` uses its OWN anonymous bundle (not RetirementBufferDebugEntry)
- The `regfile.io.write_ports` are INPUT ports (from SCore's regfile perspective), so `.valid`, `.addr`, `.data` are readable inside SCore

Write out all the edits using the Edit tool.

26	/** Retirement buffer — tracks in-flight instructions from dispatch to commit.
27	  *
28	  * Stores (pc, inst) pairs indexed by a small circular buffer, allowing
29	  * out-of-order execution units to commit results in order.
30	  *
31	  * @param p    Design parameters.
32	  * @param size Number of entries (default 8).
33	  */
34	class RetirementBuffer(p: Parameters, size: Int = RetirementBufferConfig.size)
35	    extends Module {
36	
37	  private val idxWidth = log2Ceil(size) + 1
38	
39	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
40	    // Allocate a slot on instruction dispatch
41	    val alloc = Flipped(Valid(new Bundle {
42	      val pc   = UInt(32.W)
43	      val inst = UInt(32.W)
44	    }))
45	    // Index assigned to the allocated slot
46	    val allocIdx = Output(UInt(idxWidth.W))
47	
48	    // Commit (retire) an instruction
49	    val commit = Flipped(Valid(new Bundle {
50	      val idx  = UInt(idxWidth.W)
51	      val data = UInt(32.W)
52	      val trap = Bool()
53	    }))
54	
55	    // Debug visibility
56	    val entries = Vec(size, Output(new RetirementBufferDebugEntry))
57	    val full    = Output(Bool())
58	    val empty   = Output(Bool())
59	  })
60	
61	  // Circular buffer of entries
62	  val pcMem   = Reg(Vec(size, UInt(32.W)))
63	  val instMem = Reg(Vec(size, UInt(32.W)))
64	  val valid   = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(size)(false.B)))
65	
66	  val headPtr = RegInit(0.U(idxWidth.W))
67	  val tailPtr = RegInit(0.U(idxWidth.W))
68	
69	  private def ptr(p: UInt) = p(log2Ceil(size) - 1, 0)
70	
71	  io.full  := (headPtr(log2Ceil(size)) =/= tailPtr(log2Ceil(size))) &&
72	              (ptr(headPtr) === ptr(tailPtr))
73	  io.empty := headPtr === tailPtr
74	
75	  io.allocIdx := headPtr
76	
77	  when(io.alloc.valid && !io.full) {
78	    pcMem(ptr(headPtr))   := io.alloc.bits.pc
79	    instMem(ptr(headPtr)) := io.alloc.bits.inst
80	    valid(ptr(headPtr))   := true.B
81	    headPtr               := headPtr + 1.U
82	  }
83	
84	  when(io.commit.valid) {
85	    valid(ptr(io.commit.bits.idx)) := false.B
86	    tailPtr := tailPtr + 1.U
87	  }
88	
89	  for (i <- 0 until size) {
90	    io.entries(i).pc   := pcMem(i)
91	    io.entries(i).inst := instMem(i)
92	    io.entries(i).idx  := i.U
93	    io.entries(i).data := 0.U
94	    io.entries(i).trap := false.B
95	  }

125	  fabricMux.io.source.readDataAddr.bits   := l1d.io.mem.addr
126	  fabricMux.io.source.writeDataAddr.valid := l1d.io.mem.valid && l1d.io.mem.write
127	  fabricMux.io.source.writeDataAddr.bits  := l1d.io.mem.addr
128	  fabricMux.io.source.writeDataBits       := l1d.io.mem.wdata
129	  fabricMux.io.source.writeDataStrb       := l1d.io.mem.wmask
130	
131	  for (i <- 0 until memRegions.length) { fabricMux.io.periBusy(i) := false.B }
132	
133	  l1d.io.mem.ready := fabricMux.io.source.readDataAddr.ready ||
134	                      fabricMux.io.source.writeDataAddr.ready
135	  l1d.io.mem.rdata := fabricMux.io.source.readData.bits
136	
137	  // ── ITCM dbus port ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
138	  val itcmPort  = fabricMux.io.ports(0)
139	  val itcmDbWr  = itcmPort.writeDataAddr.valid
140	  val itcmDbEn  = itcmPort.readDataAddr.valid || itcmPort.writeDataAddr.valid
141	
142	  when(itcmDbEn) {
143	    itcm.io.cpu.en    := true.B
144	    itcm.io.cpu.we    := itcmDbWr
145	    itcm.io.cpu.addr  := Mux(itcmDbWr,
146	      itcmPort.writeDataAddr.bits(log2Ceil(p.itcmSizeBytes) - 1, 0),
147	      itcmPort.readDataAddr.bits (log2Ceil(p.itcmSizeBytes) - 1, 0))
148	    itcm.io.cpu.wdata := itcmPort.writeDataBits
149	    itcm.io.cpu.wmask := itcmPort.writeDataStrb
150	    l1i.io.mem.ready  := false.B  // stall ibus when dbus wins ITCM port
151	  }
152	
153	  itcmPort.readDataAddr.ready  := true.B
154	  itcmPort.writeDataAddr.ready := true.B
155	  itcmPort.readData.valid      := RegNext(itcmPort.readDataAddr.valid)
156	  itcmPort.readData.bits       := itcm.io.cpu.rdata
157	
158	  // ── DTCM dbus port ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
159	  val dtcmPort = fabricMux.io.ports(1)
160	  val dtcmDbWr = dtcmPort.writeDataAddr.valid
161	  val dtcmDbEn = dtcmPort.readDataAddr.valid || dtcmPort.writeDataAddr.valid
162	
163	  dtcm.io.cpu.en    := dtcmDbEn
164	  dtcm.io.cpu.we    := dtcmDbWr
165	  dtcm.io.cpu.addr  := Mux(dtcmDbWr,
166	    dtcmPort.writeDataAddr.bits(log2Ceil(p.dtcmSizeBytes) - 1, 0),
167	    dtcmPort.readDataAddr.bits (log2Ceil(p.dtcmSizeBytes) - 1, 0))
168	  dtcm.io.cpu.wdata := dtcmPort.writeDataBits
169	  dtcm.io.cpu.wmask := dtcmPort.writeDataStrb
170	
171	  dtcmPort.readDataAddr.ready  := true.B
172	  dtcmPort.writeDataAddr.ready := true.B
173	  dtcmPort.readData.valid      := RegNext(dtcmPort.readDataAddr.valid)
174	  dtcmPort.readData.bits       := dtcm.io.cpu.rdata
175	
176	  // ── External AXI master ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
177	  val extPort = fabricMux.io.ports(2)
178	
179	  if (p.useAxi) {
180	    val dbus2axi = Module(new DBus2AxiV2(p))
181	
182	    dbus2axi.io.dbus.valid := extPort.readDataAddr.valid || extPort.writeDataAddr.valid
183	    dbus2axi.io.dbus.addr  := Mux(extPort.writeDataAddr.valid,
184	      extPort.writeDataAddr.bits + EXT_BASE.U,
185	      extPort.readDataAddr.bits  + EXT_BASE.U)
186	    dbus2axi.io.dbus.write := extPort.writeDataAddr.valid
187	    dbus2axi.io.dbus.wdata := extPort.writeDataBits
188	    dbus2axi.io.dbus.wmask := extPort.writeDataStrb
189	    dbus2axi.io.dbus.size  := (p.lsuDataBits / 8).U
190	
191	    extPort.readDataAddr.ready  := dbus2axi.io.dbus.ready && !extPort.writeDataAddr.valid
192	    extPort.writeDataAddr.ready := dbus2axi.io.dbus.ready &&  extPort.writeDataAddr.valid
193	    // Use a register to break the combinational cycle:
194	    // extPort.readData.valid must NOT depend on extPort.readDataAddr.valid because
195	    // readDataAddr.valid ← address ← regfile_bypass ← dbus.rdata ← source.readData.bits
196	    //   ← ports(2).readData.valid ← extPort.readData.valid  (cycle!)
197	    val extPendingRead = RegInit(false.B)
198	    when(dbus2axi.io.dbus.valid && !dbus2axi.io.dbus.write) {
199	      extPendingRead := true.B
200	    } .elsewhen(dbus2axi.io.dbus.ready) {
201	      extPendingRead := false.B
202	    }
203	    extPort.readData.valid      := dbus2axi.io.dbus.ready && extPendingRead
204	    extPort.readData.bits       := dbus2axi.io.dbus.rdata
205	    fabricMux.io.periBusy(2)   := extPort.readDataAddr.valid || extPort.writeDataAddr.valid
206	
207	    io.axi_master <> dbus2axi.io.axi
208	  } else {
209	    extPort.readDataAddr.ready  := false.B
210	    extPort.writeDataAddr.ready := false.B
211	    extPort.readData.valid      := false.B
212	    extPort.readData.bits       := 0.U
213	    // Tie off unused AXI master port
214	    io.axi_master.read.addr.valid        := false.B
215	    io.axi_master.read.addr.bits         := 0.U.asTypeOf(io.axi_master.read.addr.bits)
216	    io.axi_master.read.data.ready        := false.B
217	    io.axi_master.write.addr.valid       := false.B
218	    io.axi_master.write.addr.bits        := 0.U.asTypeOf(io.axi_master.write.addr.bits)
219	    io.axi_master.write.data.valid       := false.B
220	    io.axi_master.write.data.bits        := 0.U.asTypeOf(io.axi_master.write.data.bits)
221	    io.axi_master.write.resp.ready       := false.B
222	  }
223	
224	  // ── AXI slave back-door ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
225	  if (p.useAxi || p.useTlul) {
226	    val axiSlv = Module(new AxiSlave(p))
227	    axiSlv.io.axi    <> io.axi_slave
228	    axiSlv.io.csrAxi <> csrMod.io.axi
229	
230	    // ITCM back-door (word-addressed → byte-addressed)
231	    val itcmBdByteAddr = Cat(axiSlv.io.itcm.addr, 0.U(log2Ceil(128 / 8).W))
232	    itcm.io.backdoor.en    := axiSlv.io.itcm.en
233	    itcm.io.backdoor.we    := axiSlv.io.itcm.we
234	    itcm.io.backdoor.addr  := itcmBdByteAddr(log2Ceil(p.itcmSizeBytes) - 1, 0)
235	    itcm.io.backdoor.wdata := axiSlv.io.itcm.wdata
236	    itcm.io.backdoor.wmask := axiSlv.io.itcm.wmask
237	    axiSlv.io.itcm.rdata   := itcm.io.backdoor.rdata
238	
239	    // DTCM back-door
240	    val dtcmBdByteAddr = Cat(axiSlv.io.dtcm.addr, 0.U(log2Ceil(128 / 8).W))
241	    dtcm.io.backdoor.en    := axiSlv.io.dtcm.en
242	    dtcm.io.backdoor.we    := axiSlv.io.dtcm.we
243	    dtcm.io.backdoor.addr  := dtcmBdByteAddr(log2Ceil(p.dtcmSizeBytes) - 1, 0)
244	    dtcm.io.backdoor.wdata := axiSlv.io.dtcm.wdata
245	    dtcm.io.backdoor.wmask := axiSlv.io.dtcm.wmask
246	    axiSlv.io.dtcm.rdata   := dtcm.io.backdoor.rdata
247	  } else {
248	    // Tie off AXI slave
249	    csrMod.io.axi.read.addr.valid      := false.B
250	    csrMod.io.axi.read.addr.bits       := 0.U.asTypeOf(csrMod.io.axi.read.addr.bits)
251	    csrMod.io.axi.read.data.ready      := false.B
252	    csrMod.io.axi.write.addr.valid     := false.B
253	    csrMod.io.axi.write.addr.bits      := 0.U.asTypeOf(csrMod.io.axi.write.addr.bits)
254	    csrMod.io.axi.write.data.valid     := false.B
255	    csrMod.io.axi.write.data.bits      := 0.U.asTypeOf(csrMod.io.axi.write.data.bits)
256	    csrMod.io.axi.write.resp.ready     := false.B
257	    // Tie off AXI slave inputs
258	    io.axi_slave.read.addr.ready       := false.B
259	    io.axi_slave.read.data.valid       := false.B
260	    io.axi_slave.read.data.bits        := 0.U.asTypeOf(io.axi_slave.read.data.bits)
261	    io.axi_slave.write.addr.ready      := false.B
262	    io.axi_slave.write.data.ready      := false.B
263	    io.axi_slave.write.resp.valid      := false.B
264	    io.axi_slave.write.resp.bits       := 0.U.asTypeOf(io.axi_slave.write.resp.bits)
265	  }
266	}

17	import chisel3._

20	/** Scalar RISC-V RV32IMF core pipeline.
21	  *
22	  * Instantiates all the scalar execution units and wires them together into a
23	  * simple in-order 1-wide pipeline.  The fetch/decode/execute/retire stages
24	  * are implemented without deep buffering to keep the design tractable.
25	  *
26	  * Top-level (Core.scala) instantiates SCore and provides the memory
27	  * subsystem (TCM / AXI bridges) around it.
28	  */
29	class SCore(p: Parameters) extends Module {
30	
31	  val nInst = p.fetchDataBits / 32
32	
33	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
34	    // ---- Memory buses -------------------------------------------------------
35	    val ibus = new IBusBundle(p.fetchDataBits)
36	    val dbus = new DBusBundle(p.lsuDataBits)
37	
38	    // ---- Boot / control -----------------------------------------------------
39	    val pcStart      = Input(UInt(32.W))
40	
41	    // ---- Interrupt inputs ---------------------------------------------------
42	    val irq          = Input(Bool())
43	    val timer_irq    = Input(Bool())
44	    val software_irq = Input(Bool())
45	
46	    // ---- Status outputs -----------------------------------------------------
47	    val wfi     = Output(Bool())
48	    val halted  = Output(Bool())
49	    val fault   = Output(Bool())
50	
51	    // ---- Debug module -------------------------------------------------------
52	    val dm_req = Flipped(Decoupled(new DebugModuleReq))
53	    val dm_rsp = Decoupled(new DebugModuleRsp)
54	
55	    // ---- CSR readback -------------------------------------------------------
56	    val csr_value = new CsrReadPort
57	
58	    // ---- Test enable --------------------------------------------------------
59	    val te = Input(Bool())
60	
61	    // ---- Dispatch debug (4 slots) -------------------------------------------
62	    val dispatch_debug = Vec(4, Output(new DispatchDebugInfo))
63	  })
64	
65	  // ── Sub-modules ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
66	  val regfile  = Module(new Regfile(p))
67	  val csr      = Module(new Csr(p))
68	  val lsu      = Module(new Lsu(p))
69	  val bru      = Module(new Bru(p))
70	  val alu      = Module(new Alu(p))
71	  val mlu      = Module(new Mlu(p))
72	  val dvu      = Module(new Dvu(p))
73	  val faultMgr = Module(new FaultManager(p))
74	  val dbg      = Module(new Debug(p))
75	  val rb       = Module(new RetirementBuffer(p))
76	  val rvvi     = Module(new RvviTrace(p))
77	  val fetchCtrl = Module(new FetchControl(p))
78	  val fetcher   = Module(new Fetcher(p))
79	
80	  // ── Default tie-offs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
81	  io.wfi    := false.B
82	  io.halted := false.B
83	  io.fault  := faultMgr.io.fault
84	
85	  faultMgr.io.report_fault := false.B
86	  faultMgr.io.fault_cause  := 0.U
87	
88	  // ── CSR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
89	  csr.io.irq          := io.irq
90	  csr.io.timer_irq    := io.timer_irq
91	  csr.io.software_irq := io.software_irq
92	  csr.io.trap_entry   := false.B
93	  csr.io.trap_cause   := 0.U
94	  csr.io.trap_pc      := 0.U
95	  csr.io.mret         := false.B
96	  csr.io.req.valid    := false.B
97	  csr.io.req.bits     := 0.U.asTypeOf(csr.io.req.bits)
98	  io.csr_value        := csr.io.value
99	
100	  // Boot address forwarded via CSR value(0)
101	  // FetchControl reads csr.value(0) as the boot address
102	  // Override boot address from io.pcStart
103	  // We set csr.value(0) = pcStart by driving a CSR write on the first cycle
104	  // (FetchControl will use csr.io.value(0) as nextPC after reset)
105	
106	  // ── Fetch control ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
107	  fetchCtrl.io.csr.value(0) := io.pcStart
108	  for (i <- 1 until 4) {
109	    fetchCtrl.io.csr.value(i) := csr.io.value.value(i)
110	  }
111	  fetchCtrl.io.branch.valid  := bru.io.branch.valid
112	  fetchCtrl.io.branch.bits   := bru.io.branch.bits
113	  fetchCtrl.io.bufferSpaces  := 8.U
114	  fetchCtrl.io.bufferRequest.nReady := 8.U
115	
116	  // ── Fetcher ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
117	  // FetchControl.fetchAddr is Decoupled; Fetcher.ctrl is Flipped(Valid)
118	  fetcher.io.ctrl.valid := fetchCtrl.io.fetchAddr.valid
119	  fetcher.io.ctrl.bits  := fetchCtrl.io.fetchAddr.bits
120	  // Always ready to accept fetch commands (no back-pressure from fetcher)
121	  fetchCtrl.io.fetchAddr.ready := true.B
122	  fetcher.io.ibus  <> io.ibus
123	
124	  // Forward fetch data back to FetchControl
125	  fetchCtrl.io.fetchData.valid      := fetcher.io.fetch.valid
126	  fetchCtrl.io.fetchData.bits.addr  := fetcher.io.fetch.bits.addr
127	  for (i <- 0 until nInst) {
128	    fetchCtrl.io.fetchData.bits.inst(i) := fetcher.io.fetch.bits.inst(i)
129	  }
130	
131	  // ── Instruction buffer / decode ─────────────────────────────────────────────
132	  // Single-entry instruction register: take inst(0) from the first fetch word.
133	  val instValid = RegInit(false.B)
134	  val instWord  = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
135	  val instPC    = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
136	
137	  when(bru.io.branch.valid) {
138	    // Flush on branch
139	    instValid := false.B
140	  }.elsewhen(fetcher.io.fetch.valid && !lsu.io.busy) {
141	    instValid := true.B
142	    instWord  := fetcher.io.fetch.bits.inst(0)
143	    instPC    := fetcher.io.fetch.bits.addr
144	  }.elsewhen(!lsu.io.busy) {
145	    instValid := false.B
146	  }
147	
148	  val decoded = Decoder.decode(instWord)
149	
150	  // ── Register file reads ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
151	  for (i <- 0 until 4) {
152	    regfile.io.read_ports(i).valid := false.B
153	    regfile.io.read_ports(i).addr  := 0.U
154	  }
155	  regfile.io.read_ports(0).valid := instValid
156	  regfile.io.read_ports(0).addr  := decoded.rs1Addr
157	  regfile.io.read_ports(1).valid := instValid
158	  regfile.io.read_ports(1).addr  := decoded.rs2Addr
159	  regfile.io.scoreboard_set      := 0.U
160	
161	  val rs1Data = regfile.io.read_ports(0).data
162	  val rs2Data = regfile.io.read_ports(1).data
163	
164	  // ── LSU ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
165	  lsu.io.req.valid           := instValid && (decoded.isLoad || decoded.isStore)
166	  lsu.io.req.bits.addr       := (rs1Data.asSInt + decoded.imm).asUInt
167	  lsu.io.req.bits.rdAddr     := decoded.rdAddr
168	  lsu.io.req.bits.op         := Mux(decoded.isStore, LsuOp.STORE, LsuOp.LOAD)
169	  lsu.io.req.bits.wdata      := rs2Data
170	  lsu.io.req.bits.size       := decoded.size
171	  lsu.io.req.bits.signExt    := decoded.signExtLoad
172	  lsu.io.dbus                <> io.dbus
173	
174	  // ── BRU ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
175	  // Map funct3 branch type to BruOp
176	  val bruOpMap = Seq(
177	    "b000".U -> BruOp.BEQ,
178	    "b001".U -> BruOp.BNE,
179	    "b100".U -> BruOp.BLT,
180	    "b101".U -> BruOp.BGE,
181	    "b110".U -> BruOp.BLTU,
182	    "b111".U -> BruOp.BGEU,
183	  )
184	  val bruOpFromFunct3 = MuxLookup(decoded.branchType, BruOp.BEQ)(bruOpMap)
185	  val isJalr = instWord(6,0) === "b1100111".U  // JALR opcode
186	  val effectiveBruOp = Mux(decoded.isJump,
187	    Mux(isJalr, BruOp.JALR, BruOp.JAL),
188	    bruOpFromFunct3)
189	
190	  bru.io.req.valid        := instValid && (decoded.isBranch || decoded.isJump)
191	  bru.io.req.bits.op      := effectiveBruOp
192	  bru.io.req.bits.pc      := instPC
193	  bru.io.req.bits.imm     := decoded.imm
194	  bru.io.req.bits.rs1     := rs1Data
195	  bru.io.req.bits.rs2     := rs2Data
196	  bru.io.req.bits.rdAddr  := decoded.rdAddr
197	
198	  // ── Zbb ALU ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
199	  alu.io.req.valid        := instValid && decoded.isAlu2
200	  alu.io.req.bits.addr    := decoded.rdAddr
201	  alu.io.req.bits.op      := decoded.aluOp
202	  alu.io.rs1.valid        := instValid
203	  alu.io.rs1.data         := rs1Data
204	  alu.io.rs2.valid        := instValid
205	  alu.io.rs2.data         := rs2Data
206	
207	  // ── Multiply unit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
208	  for (i <- 0 until 4) {
209	    mlu.io.req(i).valid      := false.B
210	    mlu.io.req(i).bits.addr  := decoded.rdAddr
211	    mlu.io.req(i).bits.op    := MluOp.MUL
212	    mlu.io.rs1(i).valid      := instValid
213	    mlu.io.rs1(i).data       := rs1Data
214	    mlu.io.rs2(i).valid      := instValid
215	    mlu.io.rs2(i).data       := rs2Data
216	  }
217	  mlu.io.req(0).valid     := instValid && decoded.isMul
218	  mlu.io.req(0).bits.op   := decoded.mluOp
219	  mlu.io.rd.ready         := true.B
220	
221	  // ── Divide unit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
222	  dvu.io.req.valid         := instValid && decoded.isDiv
223	  dvu.io.req.bits.addr     := decoded.rdAddr
224	  dvu.io.req.bits.op       := decoded.dvuOp
225	  dvu.io.rs1.valid         := instValid
226	  dvu.io.rs1.data          := rs1Data
227	  dvu.io.rs2.valid         := instValid
228	  dvu.io.rs2.data          := rs2Data
229	  dvu.io.rd.ready          := true.B
230	
231	  // ── Write-back ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
232	  // Writeback from all execution units via write ports (port 0 reserved for debug)
233	  for (i <- 0 until 6) {
234	    regfile.io.write_ports(i).valid := false.B
235	    regfile.io.write_ports(i).addr  := 0.U
236	    regfile.io.write_ports(i).data  := 0.U
237	  }
238	
239	  // Port 0: debug
240	  dbg.io.req         <> io.dm_req
241	  dbg.io.rsp         <> io.dm_rsp
242	  dbg.io.pc          := instPC
243	  dbg.io.halted      := false.B
244	  dbg.io.regfile_read := VecInit(
245	    (0 until 32).map(i => regfile.io.read_ports(if (i < 2) i else 0).data)
246	  )
247	  regfile.io.write_ports(0).valid := dbg.io.regfile_write.valid
248	  regfile.io.write_ports(0).addr  := dbg.io.regfile_write.bits.addr
249	  regfile.io.write_ports(0).data  := dbg.io.regfile_write.bits.data
250	
251	  // Port 1: LSU
252	  regfile.io.write_ports(1).valid := lsu.io.rd.valid
253	  regfile.io.write_ports(1).addr  := lsu.io.rd.bits.addr
254	  regfile.io.write_ports(1).data  := lsu.io.rd.bits.data
255	
256	  // Port 2: BRU link register
257	  regfile.io.write_ports(2).valid := bru.io.rd.valid
258	  regfile.io.write_ports(2).addr  := bru.io.rd.bits.addr
259	  regfile.io.write_ports(2).data  := bru.io.rd.bits.data
260	
261	  // Port 3: Zbb ALU
262	  regfile.io.write_ports(3).valid := alu.io.rd.valid
263	  regfile.io.write_ports(3).addr  := alu.io.rd.bits.addr
264	  regfile.io.write_ports(3).data  := alu.io.rd.bits.data
265	
266	  // Port 4: Multiply
267	  regfile.io.write_ports(4).valid := mlu.io.rd.valid
268	  regfile.io.write_ports(4).addr  := mlu.io.rd.bits.addr
269	  regfile.io.write_ports(4).data  := mlu.io.rd.bits.data
270	
271	  // Port 5: Divide
272	  regfile.io.write_ports(5).valid := dvu.io.rd.valid
273	  regfile.io.write_ports(5).addr  := dvu.io.rd.bits.addr
274	  regfile.io.write_ports(5).data  := dvu.io.rd.bits.data
275	
276	  // CSR also produces register writes via csr.io.rd
277	  // (overlaps port 2 in a real impl; handled by priority)
278	
279	  // ── Retirement buffer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
280	  rb.io.alloc.valid         := instValid
281	  rb.io.alloc.bits.pc       := instPC
282	  rb.io.alloc.bits.inst     := instWord
283	  rb.io.commit.valid        := false.B
284	  rb.io.commit.bits         := 0.U.asTypeOf(rb.io.commit.bits)
285	
286	  // ── RVVI trace ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
287	  rvvi.io.retire.valid      := instValid
288	  rvvi.io.retire.bits.pc    := instPC
289	  rvvi.io.retire.bits.inst  := instWord
290	  rvvi.io.retire.bits.trap  := false.B
291	  rvvi.io.regfile           := VecInit(Seq.fill(32)(0.U(32.W)))
292	
293	  // ── WFI handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
